# CLI reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-cli-docs.ts from the CLI's usage text. Don't edit by hand. -->

Install: see [Quickstart](quickstart.md). Every command talks to the server in `MYBASE_API_URL` (or the one saved by `mybase login`).

## Global flags

```
--json                         Print results as JSON (errors too, on stderr)
--yes                          Skip confirmations (required without a terminal)
MYBASE_API_URL, MYBASE_TOKEN   Override the saved server and token
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 failure, 2 usage, 3 not signed in / bad token, 4 not found
```

## Sign in

```
login [--url <url>]            Sign in (saves an API token to ~/.config/mybase/config.json)
logout                         Revoke the saved token and forget it
whoami                         Show which server and account the CLI uses
version                        Show the CLI and server versions
```

## Server (install + run)

```
server setup [--dir <dir>]     Install mybase on this machine: checks Docker, generates keys, sets up
                               LAN/Tailscale access, a Cloudflare Tunnel, start on boot, and the admin
  [--yes] [--public-host <h>] [--tunnel-token <t> --domain <d>] [--port <n>] [--no-autostart]
  [--admin-user <u> --admin-password-stdin]   Without a terminal: defaults plus these flags
server status [--dir <dir>]    Containers, health, and whether mybase starts on boot
server update [--dir <dir>]    Download new images and restart (also refreshes compose.yml)
server tunnel [--dir <dir>]    Add or replace the Cloudflare Tunnel [--tunnel-token <t> --domain <d>] | --off
server database-public [--dir <dir>]   A normal postgres:// URL from anywhere: router port forward +
                               Let's Encrypt TLS + DNS kept on your IP (Cloudflare)
  [--host <db.domain> --dns-token <t> [--email <e>] [--staging]] | --off
server autostart on|off        Start mybase when this machine boots (and restart it after crashes)
Default dir: the last one setup used, else ~/mybase
```

## Update

```
update [--version <v>] [--cli] [--yes]
                               Update this CLI to the latest release (or <v>), then the server on this
                               machine, if there is one. --cli: only the CLI
```

## API keys

```
token list                     List API keys and what they may do
token create <name> (--perm <p,…> [--project <name,…>] [--env <env,…>] | --admin)
                               Make a key and print it once. <p>: <resource>:read|write,
                               resources: projects, database, storage, cron, analytics, cache, ratelimit, queue, search, secrets, vector, users, captcha, audit
                               --env limits secrets to those environments
token update <id> [--name <n>] [--perm <p,…>] [--project <name,…>|--all-projects]
       [--env <env,…>|--all-envs] [--admin]
token delete <id>              Revoke a key (it stops working now)
```

## Projects

```
project create <name>          Create a new project (database + storage bucket)
project list                   List projects
project delete <name> [--yes]  Delete a project, its database, and all its files
```

## Project context

```
context <project>              Services, connection details, tables, jobs, queues, env vars (no secrets)
```

## doctor

```
doctor [<project>]             Security checks: the whole instance (admin key), or one project. Exits 1 on critical findings
```

## audit

```
audit [--project p] [--action auth|auth.login] [--outcome ok|denied|failed] [--since 24h|7d|<ISO date>] [--limit n] [--follow]
                               Recent audit log entries, newest first (--follow: keep printing new ones)
audit retention [<days>]       Show (or set, 7–365, admin key) how long entries are kept
```

## alerts

```
alerts                         Alert channels and rules (admin key)
alerts add webhook|ntfy <url> [--name n] [--token t]  Send alerts to a webhook (signed) or an ntfy topic URL
alerts test <channel-id>       Send a test alert and wait for the result
alerts remove <channel-id> [--yes]  Stop sending alerts there
alerts rotate <channel-id>     New webhook signing secret
alerts rule <rule> on|off      Turn one rule on or off (rule ids: see `mybase alerts`)
```

## Docs

```
docs                           List docs pages
docs <slug>                    Print a page as markdown (e.g. quickstart, queues, sdk/queues)
docs --search "<words>" [--limit 5]  Best matching sections, with links
```

## MCP setup

```
mcp [--key-env MYBASE_API_KEY] Print MCP setup for Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, and others
```

## Agent setup

```
agent init [--project <name>] [--dir .] [--key] [--no-agents-md] [--no-skill] [--no-mcp]
                               Teach coding agents about mybase in an app repo: AGENTS.md notes,
                               a Claude skill, and .mcp.json. --key also makes a project-limited
                               API key and puts it in .env.local (only if git ignores it)
```

## Cron

```
cron enable <project>          Turn on cron for a project and print its signing secret
cron disable <project> [--yes] Turn it off, deleting every job and its history
cron list <project>            List jobs
cron create <project> <name> --schedule "<cron>" --url <url>
       [--tz <zone>] [--retries <n>] [--timeout <ms>] [--payload '<json>'] [--paused]
cron delete <project> <name>   Delete a job
cron run <project> <name>      Run a job now
cron runs <project> <name>     Show a job's recent runs
cron tasks <project> [--status <status>]  List one-off tasks (newest first)
cron schedule <project> <job> --url <url> [--in 15m | --at <iso date>]
       [--key <key>] [--payload '<json>'] [--retries <n>] [--timeout <ms>]
                               Call <job> once (apps do this with createCronClient)
cron cancel <project> <task id | --key <key>>  Cancel a pending task
cron secret <project> [--rotate]  Show (or replace) the signing secret
cron sync [--config <file>] [--dry-run]  Make code-defined jobs match mybase.config.ts
```

## Analytics

```
analytics enable <project>     Turn on analytics and print the write key and snippets
analytics disable <project> [--yes]  Turn it off, deleting every recorded event
analytics key <project> [--rotate]   Show (or replace) the public write key
analytics stats <project> [--range 24h|7d|30d|90d]  Totals and top routes, events, errors
```

## Cache

```
cache enable <project>         Turn on the cache and print its password and connection strings
cache disable <project> [--yes]  Turn it off, deleting every key
cache info <project>           Connection details, key count, and memory use
cache password <project> --rotate  Replace the password (the old one stops working now)
```

## Rate limits

```
ratelimit enable <project>     Turn on rate limits
ratelimit disable <project> [--yes]  Turn them off, deleting every rule and counter
ratelimit rules <project>      List rules
ratelimit create <project> <name> --limit <n> --window <10s|1m|1h|…>
       [--algorithm sliding|fixed|token] [--burst <n>]
ratelimit delete <project> <name>  Delete a rule
ratelimit stats <project> [--range 24h|7d]  Allowed and blocked requests per rule
ratelimit sync [--config <file>] [--dry-run]  Make code-defined rules match mybase.config.ts
```

## Queues

```
queue enable <project>         Turn on queues
queue disable <project> [--yes]  Turn them off, deleting every queue and message
queue list <project>           List queues with message counts
queue create <project> <name> [--fifo] [--visibility 30s] [--delay 0s] [--retention 4d]
       [--wait 0s] [--max-bytes <n>] [--content-dedup] [--dlq <queue> --max-receives <n>]
queue delete <project> <name> [--yes]  Delete a queue and its messages
queue purge <project> <name> [--yes]   Delete every message in a queue
queue send <project> <name> <body> [--group <id>] [--dedup <id>] [--delay 30s]
queue peek <project> <name> [--limit 20]  Show messages without receiving them
queue receive <project> <name> [--max 1] [--wait 0s] [--delete]  Receive (and optionally delete)
queue redrive <project> <dlq> [--to <queue>]  Move dead letters back to their queues
queue stats <project> [--range 24h|7d]  Sent, received, deleted, dead-lettered per queue
queue sync [--config <file>] [--dry-run] [--yes]  Make code-defined queues match mybase.config.ts
```

## search

```
search enable <project>        Turn on web search (SearXNG) for apps and agents
search disable <project> [--yes]  Turn it off, clearing cached searches and pages
```

## secrets

```
secrets enable <project>       Turn on secrets (dev, staging, prod to start)
secrets disable <project> [--yes]  Turn them off, deleting every env, value, and revision
secrets setup -p <project> -e <env>  Use this project + env in this directory (and below)
secrets envs                   List environments
secrets env create <name> [--from <root env>]  Create an env (a branch env with --from)
secrets env rename <name> <new name>
secrets env delete <name> [--yes]  Delete an env, its branch envs, and their history
secrets list [--values]        List keys (values hidden unless --values)
secrets get <KEY>              Print one value
secrets set <KEY=value>… [--message <m>]  Set keys (KEY=- reads the value from stdin)
secrets unset <KEY>… [--message <m>]
secrets upload <.env file> [--message <m>]  Set every key in a .env file
secrets history [--limit 20]   Revisions, newest first
secrets restore <revision> [--yes]  Put values back as they were after <revision>
secrets link --env <env,…> [--yes]  Rotate the project's DB/S3/cache credentials and keep them
                               in these envs (DATABASE_URL, S3_*, REDIS_URL, MYBASE_URL)
secrets unlink [--yes]         Remove the credentials from the env (they stay valid)
                               Project/env: -p/--project, -e/--env, else MYBASE_PROJECT/MYBASE_ENV,
                               else `secrets setup` for this directory
```

## vector

```
vector enable <project>        Turn on vector + full-text search
vector disable <project> [--yes]  Turn it off, deleting every index and document
vector settings <project>      Show the embedding provider
vector embedding <project> --url <url> --model <m> --dims <n> [--key]  Set it (--key prompts for an API key)
vector embedding <project> --off  Remove it
vector list <project>          List indexes with document counts
vector create <project> <index> [--dims <n>] [--metric cosine|l2|ip] [--lang english] [--embed]
vector delete <project> <index> [--yes]  Delete an index and its documents
vector upsert <project> <index> <file.jsonl>  Upsert documents, one JSON object per line
vector documents <project> <index> [--limit 20] [--after <id>]  List documents in id order
vector query <project> <index> [<text>] [--mode text|vector|hybrid] [--top 10] [--filter <json>]
vector sync [--config <file>] [--dry-run] [--yes]  Make code-defined indexes match mybase.config.ts
```

## users

```
users enable <project>         Turn on users: an auth schema for Better Auth, plus setup steps
users init <project> [--env <secrets env>]  Print an auth.ts for Better Auth; --env stores a new BETTER_AUTH_SECRET there
users list <project> [--search <text>]  The app's users, newest first
users show <project> <user-id>  One user: sign-in methods and active sessions
users revoke <project> <user-id> [<session-id>]  Sign a user out (one session, or everywhere)
users delete <project> <user-id> [--yes]  Delete a user and their sessions
users disable <project> [--yes]  Turn it off, deleting every user account
```

## captcha

```
captcha enable <project>       Turn on the captcha and print the script tag and secret
captcha key <project> [--rotate]  Show (or replace) the secret your server checks tokens with
captcha difficulty <project> <n>  Numbers a browser may try per challenge (1000–1000000; default 50000)
captcha disable <project> [--yes]  Turn it off (forms that need it stop accepting submissions)
```

## run

```
run [-p <project>] [-e <env>] [--preserve-env] -- <command> [args…]
                               Start <command> with the env's secrets as env vars
                               (--preserve-env: vars already set win over secrets)
```

## Agent notes

- Add `--json` whenever you parse output; read errors from stderr as JSON.
- `mybase help <command>` prints one command's usage.
